title: Difference of standardized signs
statement: For a real number $p$ with $0<p<1$, let $\sigma_p$ be the square root of $4p(1-p)$ and let the standardized value of a sign $s\in\{\pm1\}$ be $(s-(1-2p))/\sigma_p$. Then $\sigma_p$ times the difference between the standardized values at $1$ and $-1$, divided by $2$, equals $1$.
